name: groundline
description: Groundline: a grounded AI customer-support assistant with an operator console and an embeddable widget.
author: Dominic

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,blue "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w server
scripts.test: npm test -w server && npm test -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
